claim: The third fiscal quarter of 2026 filing showed total assets down 18% for Tesla.
summary: The claim concerns Tesla's Q3 2026 filing reporting total assets down 18%. With a knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04, the Q3 2026 period (ending September 30, 2026, filing in late October 2026) is beyond established knowledge, so neither the existence of the filing nor the 18% decline can be verified without tools.

sub_claims.stated_text: The third fiscal quarter of 2026 filing
sub_claims.note: No information about Q3 2026 filings is available within the model's knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04; the filing would occur around late October 2026, after both the cutoff and today's date of 2026-10-28, and cannot be verified without tools.

sub_claims.text: Tesla's total assets were down 18% as shown in that filing
